disambiguation: Not a general collaboration tool; it provides quote-anchored review threads stored at the end of the file.
extras: Supports skill export for Claude Code and Codex to teach AI agents the comment format.
intentEvidence: Tandem Comments keeps the block at the very end, even if you type below it or add footnotes after it.
problem: Traditional inline comments disrupt plain-text workflows, clutter exports, and complicate diff comparisons.
summary: A Google Docs-style commenting system that stores review threads in a quote-anchored block at the end of the Markdown file.
